text:
Maya P: quick flag 18 accounts stuck at 'onboarding:waiting' even though we've seen webhooks from LMS. Noticed during renewal risk review.
Diego H: I saw a queued webhook backlog earlier today, delivery latencies spiked to ~4m. Could be the lambda retry throttling.
Maya P: Hmm. These are all accounts created in the last 7 days via trial-signup flow. status_history shows 'webhook_received' but not 'profile_synced'.
Rina S: Does the playbook have an idempotent reconcile step? If webhook handler failed after ack we might not have retried metadata enrichment.
Diego H: Playbook 'trial-onboard-v1' has enrichment job, but it's gated behind rate_limit < 100/s check. Our infra team bumped global webhook concurrency down last week.
Maya P: Can we run a manual reconcile for the stuck cohort before we notify CS owners? We don't want renewal risk alerts for customers who are actually onboarded.
ops-bot: queued job 'reconcile-onboard-cohort-1822224444' created by Maya P 12025-10-28T16:05Z. ETA: 30m.
Rina S: Manual SQL sample to identify affected accounts:
```
SELECT id, company, status, metadata->>'last_event' AS last_event
FROM accounts
WHERE status = 'onboarding:waiting' AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days';
```
Diego H: For safety, run the reconcile in dry-run mode first and capture diffs:
```
python tools/reconcile.py --cohort 1822224444 --dry-run --output /tmp/reconcile-diff.json
```
Maya P: Running dry-run now. If results look good, we'll schedule a staggered backfill: 100 -> 500 -> all over 2 hours.
playbook-bot: dry-run complete 12025-10-28T16:18Z 125 candidates would transition to 'onboarded'; 0 errors. Artifacts: s3://redwood-playbooks/dryrun/1822224444.json
Rina S: Nice. For the production run, add a safety latch: if >1% of accounts have metadata mismatch (email missing, name missing), abort and surface to ops.
Diego H: Also add a metric emission: cs.playbook.reconcile.attempt and .success with tag cohort=1822224444 and counts.
Maya P: Agreed. I'll update the CS ticket with the dry-run link and queue the prod run for 16:45 UTC. Diego, can you review the concurrency override?
Diego H: Yep. I'll temporarily bump webhook concurrency for the reconcile window and monitor lambda error rates. If errors > 0.2% I'll roll back.
ops-bot: scheduled job 'reconcile-onboard-cohort-1822224444-prod' at 2025-10-28T16:45Z.
Maya P: Prod run finished: 125 accounts transitioned. No errors, median NPS prereq unchanged. Sending note to CS owners to suppress false renewal flags for 48h while we monitor.
Rina S: Follow-up: opened PR to add a post-prune reconcile step to 'trial-onboard-v1' with telemetry and safety-latch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/pull/489
Diego H: LGTM on PR. Suggest including an automated test that simulates webhook lag and validates the reconcile idempotency.
Maya P: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread after I file a short blameless retro in retro repo. :white_check_mark:
